sources.summary: The first full look at the big-budget December tentpole features returning heroes such as Chris Hemsworth, Patrick Stewart, Florence Pugh and Chris Evans The first full trailer for Avengers: Doomsday has been released online offering a look at Marvel’s big-budget big hope. “Something’s coming, something we may not be able to deter,” is the first line heard in the new preview which proceeds to bring back multiple characters from various Marvel movies and universes.
